Second door (event-pages-sitemap.xml): 28 date-stamped slugs on or after the recon date = the 15 dated widget rows + 13 later instances; third door: the 12 cached event pages, whose JSON-LD matches their rows one for one and whose 'Other dates' blocks name the same later instances the sitemap holds (Manbears 14 Nov / 12 Dec, Spank Guys 21 Nov / 19 Dec and 6 Nov / 4 Dec, Collared 7 Nov / 5 Dec, Hanky Panky 28 Nov, Locker Room 14 Nov / 9 Jan); the one later single with no cached page (Suck My Disco 7 Nov) was fetched. Past listings: none served by the widget; 1300-odd older sitemap pages are history, not enumerated. Run 20260912-152153 returned the 18 first-page rows (5 kept, 13 bear-dropped).
